iterations.plan: I need to implement a bowling scorer that handles frames 1-9 with standard bonus rules (strikes and spares get bonus points from following rolls), and frame 10 with special rules (no extra rolls, bonuses only count existing rolls).
iterations.code:
def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    # Process frames 1-9
    for frame in range(9):
        if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
            score += 10
            # Add next two rolls as bonus (if they exist)
            if roll_idx + 1 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 1]
            if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 1
        elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
            score += 10
            # Add next roll as bonus (if it exists)
            if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Open frame
            score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
            roll_idx += 2
    
    # Process frame 10 (no bonuses, just add the rolls)
    while roll_idx < len(rolls):
        score += rolls[roll_idx]
        roll_idx += 1
    
    return score
